title: Q-STD-datacite: Read replications by DOI from Crossref and publish ledger records with DataCite metadata
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 register entry `datacite-crossref` is planned or partial in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe datacite-crossref
**Status:** open

In the replication-ledger tenant repository, resolve each finding and replication by DOI through the Crossref REST API and serve each ledger record with DataCite Metadata Schema 4.5 fields and schema.org ScholarlyArticle JSON-LD.

**Prediction:** ledger_records_with_doi_share >= 0.8 within 336 h

**Out of scope:** Minting DOIs (an identity-bound registration).

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation openstd --probe datacite-crossref` exits 0.
